svg.title: Contribution jet — chandanB47
svg.desc: An animated jet flies across the GitHub contribution graph of chandanB47 and shoots down 88 active days, keeping score, then the graph respawns and the game loops.

g.text: EVERY GLOWING CELL IS A DAY I SHOWED UP. THE JET CLEARS THEM — THEN THEY RESPAWN.
SOURCE / GITHUB CONTRIBUTION GRAPH — REFRESHED BY GITHUB ACTIONS
